Rajiv Gandhi Death: Sonia Gandhi remembers Rajiv Gandhi's Bihar tour and how stones were pelted at him. Sonia Gandhi says that at that time Rahul Gandhi had warned her about Rajiv Gandhi's security, saying if nothing is done he will be coming back for a funeral.
